title: 3dTsmooth
description: Smooths each voxel time series in a 3D+time dataset and produces as output a new 3D+time dataset (e.g., lowpass filter in time).

prefix.description: Sets the prefix of the output dataset.
prefix.title: Output Prefix

datum_type.description: Coerce output dataset to be stored as the given type.
datum_type.title: Datum Type

lin_filter_custom.description: 3 point linear filter with custom weight: 0.5*(1-m)*a + m*b + 0.5*(1-m)*c
lin_filter_custom.title: Custom Linear Filter

hamming.description: Use N point Hamming window filter.
hamming.title: Hamming Window Filter

blackman.description: Use N point Blackman window filter.
blackman.title: Blackman Window Filter

custom_filter.description: Use custom filter with coefficients from a specified file.
custom_filter.title: Custom Filter File

extend.description: BEFORE: use the first value; AFTER: use the last value.
extend.title: Extend Values

trend.description: Compute a linear trend, and extrapolate BEFORE and AFTER.
trend.title: Trend Extrapolation

adaptive.description: Use adaptive mean filtering of width N (N must be odd and bigger than 3).
adaptive.title: Adaptive Mean Filtering Width
